Also there is "非法持有" no. "破坏" because they caused fire? They burned equipment inadvertently. Not intentional arson. So maybe "盗窃" only.

For theft of oil and vehicle, both are theft, but maybe they consider "盗窃" and "非法占有" not separate. So answer likely "盗窃". However there is also "非法占有" not a separate crime.
